author: Kai Moreno
title: Console log retention settings
content:
# Purpose
How long request metadata stays visible in Console. Default 14 days on Hosted, 30 on Dedicated.

# When to use
How long request metadata stays visible in Console. Default 14 days on Hosted, 30 on Dedicated.

# What Support does
P4, Support. They can lower retention in Console. They cannot raise Hosted above 14 days. A longer archive in their cloud is the customer-managed export SOP, not this toggle.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P4, Support. They can lower retention in Console. They cannot raise Hosted above 14 days. A longer archive in their cloud is the customer-managed export SOP, not this toggle. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
